title: Model outage on the first morning of mock exams

text: First day of Grade 12 mock exams: the model provider returns HTTP 429/503 and the free daily quota is exhausted. Revision plans, reminders and Q&A for about 1,900 students stop generating.

rationale: Matched tags ['model_outage'] to my mandate; actions are taken from my rule table and each is grounded in the best-matching excerpt from my sources.

actions.action: Fail over to the deterministic rule engine and cached plans so students keep access to their schedules and notes; tell schools what is degraded.

text: Teachers report students cannot open their AI revision notes before the 10:00 paper; parents are calling the school.

gaps.title: The same AI tutor falls under different data-protection regimes depending on who deploys it
No binding risk class, logging duty or incident channel for AI systems used with students
Approved-tool and age rules cover MoE-curriculum schools; Dubai private schools on other curricula wait for KHDA
Exam contingency rules cover cancelled exam boards, not failing AI services
Low-cost model access pushes student data across borders on terms schools cannot check
